def forward(groups):
    parts = groups[0].split('.')
    seconds = int(parts[0])
    micros = int(parts[1])
    return {'stored': [seconds * 1000000 + micros], 'layout': [len(parts[1])]}

def inverse(record):
    value = record['stored'][0]
    micros = value % 1000000
    seconds = value // 1000000
    micros_str = str(micros).zfill(record['layout'][0])
    return f"{seconds}.{micros_str}"
